owner: W1-07 — character creation (the AR-3 seam crossing)

ar3_rule.legal_lever: WHETHER, WHEN and HOW an encounter aggros, and what parley it offers.
ar3_rule.illegal_lever: Any change to hp, poise, damage, archetype, moveset, frame data or attack selection as a function of the player's race. That is Morrowind reaching into the fight and is an automatic AR-1 fail (RI-CHR02 'how we lose' #4).
ar3_rule.enforcement: Every member of every encounter below names an EXISTING statblock id. The statblock is loaded once and is invariant to race by construction — there is no per-race statblock and no per-race override field in this schema. tools/analysis/creation-audit.mjs --section ar3 asserts the schema contains no such field.

encounters.name: Dres raid party
encounters.member_note: Six members in wave 1. RI-CHR02 §4e specifies 4-6 INFANTRY + 1 CASTER + 2 net-throwers; the CASTER is absent because W1-07 does not own a caster statblock and inventing one would be inventing frame data. The absence is declared, not hidden.
encounters.hail_line: Hold up. You are not what we are out here for. — Are you buying? We have four and one of them can read.
encounters.capture_line: Nets. Nets, not blades, that one is worth the walk back.
encounters.khajiit_line: Take it. Nobody writes a receipt for a cat.

parley.note: S13 / RI-CHR02 method 11: every parley must have at least one route that is not disposition-gated, or a race term alone can close every non-lethal exit. Here that route is knowledge — the name of the ship — and it is available to a Saxhleel at disposition 0.

encounters.name: Deep-Kin war-brood camp
encounters.behaviour_note: RI-CHR02 §4e mechanism 2. Not a race table — a DISPOSITION threshold, which the race term happens to push a Dunmer under all by itself. An entire tier-3/4 region's encounter density is therefore a function of what the Warden-Scribe wrote down.

parley.note: The Twin Lamps password is race-blind and disposition-blind (RI-CHR02 §6). It is the reason a Dunmer at disposition 6 still has a non-lethal exit here.
